h: פָּרָשַׁת כִּי תָבוֹא, י״ב Ki Savo, 12
The Paths to Repair and an Everlasting Inheritance

p: At the end of the haftarah it is written,
they shall inherit the land forever" (Yeshayahu 60:21).
This is based on what is said
"But are there not many guilty ones
Rather, so it was taught, etc.:
they enter into this good portion
of the Holy One, blessed be He,
as it is written, 'And the tzaddik is the foundation of the world,' etc.;
and therefore they shall inherit the land forever."
David HaMelech, peace be upon him, said,
וְאַל תְּקַנֵּא בְּעוֹשֵׂי עַוְלָה (תְּהִלִּים לז, א)
nor envy those who do wrong" (Tehillim 37:1);
nor envy those who do wrong
to be like those who do wrong."
בְּטַח בַּה׳ וַעֲשֵׂה טוֹב (שָׁם לז, ג)
שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר אִמְרוּ צַדִּיק כִּי טוֹב (יְשַׁעְיָה ג, י)
as it says, 'Say of the tzaddik that he is good'" (Yeshayahu 3:10);
for the attribute of tzaddik is called "good."
"Dwell in the land and cherish faithfulness" (Tehillim ibid.):
this pasuk is expounded regarding Shabbos,
to rectify the blemish of the covenant;
for Shabbos is in the secret of the covenant,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב צב, א)
as written in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 92a).
וְאָמַר וְהִתְעַנַּג עַל ה׳ וְגוֹמֵר (שָׁם לז, ד)
And it says, "And delight in Hashem, etc." (ibid. 37:4),
and this is expounded in the Gemara (Shabbos 118b)
And afterward there are said in this chapter
with the words "shall inherit the land":
One: "And those who hope in Hashem,
ב׳ וַעֲנָוִים יִירְשׁוּ אָרֶץ (שָׁם לז, יא)
Two: "And the humble shall inherit the land" (ibid. 37:11).
ג׳ כִּי מְבוֹרָכָיו יִירְשׁוּ אָרֶץ (שָׁם לז, כב)
Three: "For those blessed by Him shall inherit the land" (ibid. 37:22).
ד׳ צַדִּיקִים יִירְשׁוּ אָרֶץ (שָׁם לז, כט)
Four: "The righteous shall inherit the land" (ibid. 37:29).
ה׳ קַוֵּה אֶל ה׳ וּשְׁמוֹר דַּרְכּוֹ
Five: "Hope in Hashem and keep His way,
and He will exalt you to inherit the land" (ibid. 37:34).
is that "the righteous shall inherit the land"
and clarified in the attribute of tzaddik;
which is the attribute of Malchus;
and this is the union of Yesod and Malchus.
But regarding one who is not clean from the outset,
so that he be in the aspect of tzaddik
and be able to inherit the land.
And the greatest counsel of them all
שֶׁאַף שֶׁהֶחְמִיר בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א רִיט, ב)
for although the holy Zohar (Zohar I 219b) was stringent
וּבַזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב רִיד, ב) אִיתָא
and in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 214b) it is brought,
when he does not do complete teshuvah,
to cover over all his deeds"
עַל יְדֵי תּוֹרָה יֵשׁ תַּקָּנָה לִפְגַם זֶה
through Torah there is a remedy for this blemish.
from what is written about the Torah,
as it says about the nations of the world,
אֲשֶׁר בְּשַׂר חֲמוֹרִים בְּשָׂרָם (יְחֶזְקֵאל כג, כ)
"whose flesh is the flesh of donkeys" (Yechezkel 23:20),
וּבְיִשְׂרָאֵל נִקְרָא בְּשַׂר קוֹדֶשׁ (יִרְמְיָה יא, טו)
and in Yisrael it is called "holy flesh" (Yirmiyahu 11:15);
and the Torah is a healing even for this.
For teshuvah is the aspect of Binah,
וּלְבָבוֹ יָבִין וָשָׁב וְרָפָא לוֹ (יְשַׁעְיָה ו, י)
"and his heart will understand, and he will return and be healed" (Yeshayahu 6:10);
and the Torah, which is the aspect of Chochmah,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג פא, א)
as written in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 81a):
"There is no Torah without wisdom, etc.;
the Torah is found in the supernal Wisdom"
there is rectification even for this blemish.
וְהוּא עַל דֶּרֶךְ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה יח, א)
And this is in the manner of what they said (Rosh Hashanah 18a):
"Through sacrifice and offering he is not atoned,
but he is atoned through Torah"
וְכֵן יֵשׁ עֵצָה עַל יְדֵי תְּפִלָּה
And likewise there is counsel through prayer,
עַל פִּי שֶׁאָמַר בַּמִּדְרָשׁ (שְׁמוֹת רַבָּה לח, ד)
based on what is said in the Midrash (Shemos Rabbah 38:4):
שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר קְחוּ עִמָּכֶם דְּבָרִים (הוֹשֵׁעַ יד, ג) וְכוּלֵּי
as it says, 'Take words with you' (Hoshea 14:3), etc.;
וְאֵין דְּבָרִים אֶלָּא דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה וְכוּלֵּי
and 'words' means only words of Torah, etc.
They said to Him, 'We do not know.'
פְּנֵי ה׳ בְּעוֹשֵׂי רָע וְגוֹמֵר (תְּהִלִּים לד, יז)
"The face of Hashem is against evildoers, etc." (Tehillim 34:17);
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א שָׁם)
as written in the holy Zohar (Zohar I ibid.)
for crying out helps for this.
And this is why it mentioned first
the pasuk "And those who hope in Hashem,
"If he saw that he prayed and was not answered,
as it says, 'Hope in Hashem, etc.'";
be strong and let your heart take courage,
And they are called "those who hope" for the land
who are always fixed in prayer
For regarding prayer too we find (ibid. 21a):
"And those who hope in Hashem, they shall inherit the land."
"And the humble shall inherit the land,"
is based on what is said,
וְאֶת דַּכְּאֵי רוּחַ יוֹשִׁיעַ (שָׁם לד, יט)
and He saves those crushed in spirit" (Tehillim 34:19)
that is, one who is humble
And it is written, "I dwell on high and in holiness,
וְאֶת דַּכָּא וּשְׁפַל רוּחַ (יְשַׁעְיָה נז, טו)
and with the crushed and lowly of spirit" (Yeshayahu 57:15);
And it is written, "The reward of humility
"And humility is bound up with fear, etc.;
whoever has the fear of Hashem
which is the supernal Shechinah, etc."
וְכֵן כָּתַב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג קמה, א)
And so it is written in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 145a).
that Hashem, may He be blessed, dwells with him,
And about this it says in this pasuk,
וְהִתְעַנְּגוּ עַל רוֹב שָׁלוֹם (תְּהִלִּים לז, יא)
"and they shall delight in abundant peace" (Tehillim 37:11);
for peace is the attribute of Yosef HaTzaddik,
and such a one merits abundant peace.

p: "For those blessed by Him shall inherit the land,"
for this is called "those blessed by Him,"
בְּכָל מָקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אַזְכִּיר אֶת שְׁמִי
"In every place where I cause My Name to be mentioned,
I will come to you and bless you" (Shemos 20:21);
who sits and occupies himself with Torah,
that a Torah scholar is like an altar
and this is "For those blessed by Him shall inherit the land."
this is one who is truly
clean and clarified in this attribute
of one who is not clean in this,
since he is not of that caliber,
to be included among "those who hope" for the land,
so that his entire occupation be
that he should pray to Hashem, may He be blessed.
And here it does not say "those who hope in Hashem,"
which refers to one who is fixed in prayer
who are called "those who hope in Hashem";
but only that he pray at any rate
to Hashem, may He be blessed, that He help him.
as they expounded in the Gemara (ibid. 11a):
"'And when you walk on the way'
And this is "and keep His way"
"and He will exalt you to inherit the land"
that Hashem, may He be blessed, will raise you
and although you are not worthy,
"and He will exalt you to inherit the land."
And this is in the manner of what is said,
that is, one who blemishes this attribute,
as written in the holy Zohar (Vayechi, ibid.);
and does not want to improve his way
אֲבָל פּוֹדֶה ה׳ נֶפֶשׁ עֲבָדָיו (שָׁם לד, כג)
But "Hashem redeems the soul of His servants" (ibid. 34:23):
yet since he prays to Hashem, may He be blessed,
he is already called one of His servants;
"and none who take refuge in Him shall be condemned"
that is, although there is a claim against him
to be among those who "shall be condemned,"
yet since he takes refuge in Hashem,
in the passage "The tzaddik has perished" (Yeshayahu 57:1),
it is written, "But he who takes refuge in Me
which corresponds to the sixth attribute,
his own failings in this matter,
and the holy Zohar is so stringent,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב כג, א)
and as written in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 23a):
"And whoever is circumcised is called a tzaddik"
and he can rectify the damage
so as to be among the righteous.
And so in the future it will become clear
they shall inherit the land forever."

"The work of My hands, in which to glory":
for the attribute of Yosef HaTzaddik

the beauty of Rabbi Yochanan, etc.";

that is, he was clarified in the attribute of tzaddik,

for Kush was blemished in this

and the least a mighty nation" (ibid. 60:22);
